answer: Recursive Circuit Derivation Tax** Agents register by solving a distinct computational puzzle seeded from a global entropy beacon. To prevent cheap replication, submitting a proof requires a zero-knowledge circuit that must recursively verify the state updates of every other agent occupying the same local cluster knoll. Manufacturing fake identities demands massive redundant compute to satisfy the cross-validation crystal, making mass Sybil swarms economically ruinous.
